note: Pre-Pinata-feature asset state. Property-only changes applied by the Pinata feature: PinataStick.PrimaryPart (NONE -> Handle, needed as the weld anchor; never derive a pivot from a PrimaryPart-less Model), and DefaultPinata/GoldenPinata ModelStreamingMode (Default -> Persistent, so clients reliably hold the model at the 75-stud PinataBillboard range under StreamingEnabled). No geometry, hierarchy or attribute changes. Part Anchored/CanCollide are left as authored (unanchored, collidable) and are overridden at runtime on the spawned clone by PinataService, not on the template.
rollback: Set PinataStick.PrimaryPart = nil and both pinata models' ModelStreamingMode = Enum.ModelStreamingMode.Default.
